messages:
noah: Hi all, quick Q on KMS/Vault onboarding. I joined payments and need a CMK to perform envelope encryption for card blobs. Who approves and what's the expected timeline?
elena: Welcome @noah! For CMKs we require a security justification + compliance reason. Fill the secrets/KMS form and tag it 'cmk'. Include environment, data classification, and whether you need key rotation or import.
noah: Got it. Does CMK mean HSM-backed keys only? Any restrictions on usage from apps?
secops: CMKs are HSM-backed (customer-managed) and are scoped to prod/reg workloads. Apps must request envelope encryption only (use KMS to wrap DEKs) and we discourage direct CMK sign/verify unless approved.
elena: Timeline: non-sensitive dev KMS config can be 1-2 business days; prod CMK + compliance review usually 3-7 business days depending on reviewers. Add approvers (team lead + security) to speed it up.
noah: What about rotation policy — does secops manage automatic rotations?
secops: We can enforce rotation via KMS policy. Default rotation is 365d for CMKs unless compliance requires shorter. For keys that protect highly-sensitive data set a 90d max. Document rotation in the request so automation can be configured.
noah: Any examples I can paste into the form?
elena: Example: "Service: payments-processor; Env: prod; Use: envelope encryption for 30-day card blob storage; DEK lifecycle: rotate every 90d; CMK rotation: 365d; Approvers: payments-eng lead, secops."
noah: Thanks — filing now.
devex-bot: Request created SR-2026-599. Assigned to secops for review. Tracker: https://redwood-internal/requests/SR-2026-599 :white_check_mark:
